To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
1) RGB and depth modalities are complementary to each other; 2) RGB is more robust to domain shift; 3) the best performance is achieved by using the fusion of RGB and depth modalites.

(i) RGB-D modality is the most suitable input to train deep learning-based methods, (ii) dynamic gestures are easier to recognize than static ones, and (iii) the domain adaptation is an essential problem that needs to be solved for the real-world deployment.

the depth modality is more suitable than the RGB modality for the egocentric gesture recognition problem, and that the performance can be significantly improved by domain adaptation between different scenarios.
